The '''Leviathan Power Armor''' was a form of protective body [[Power armor/Legends|powersuit]] that was developed by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] people.

==Overview==
This protective [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was developed for the unique physiology of the Mon Calamari race but was capable of being modified for use by other [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] races. It was originally developed by [[Ylan Ghalir]] and was similar to the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] produced by [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in that each suit was unique and a work of art.

It was designed for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to harass [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] aquatic installations. This armor came up with a wide range of aquatic combat oriented weapons which included a [[Flechette/Legends|Flechette]] rifle and [[Mini-Torpedo Launcher]].
